title: Getting started
theme_text: The theme sets the colors, fonts and mood of your whole site.
project_title: Create a project and add images
project_text: A project gathers your images. Images you upload from a project are added to it directly.
page_text: A project is only visible if a page displays it: add a “Project” block to a page.
publish_text: Until a page is published, nobody can see it on your site.
about_text: Your name, your introduction and your email address, so people can get in touch.
